title: A sharp lower-bound construction for ordered hypergraph matchings along a fixed chain of ordered partitions
author: Lisa Sauermann, Dmitrii Zakharov
work: A Sharp Ramsey Theorem for Ordered Hypergraph Matchings
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the sharp lower-bound construction of the paper (author theorem at source lines 455-459, label thm-paramteters-lower-bound-stronger): for any chain of ordered partitions of r and any prescribed positive integers m_P, there is an ordered r-uniform hypergraph matching of the displayed product size whose every pair of edges forms a pattern in the union of the pattern families and whose pattern-cliques stay below m_P. The proof (source lines 575-593) is the author's own, headed Proof of Theorem thm-paramteters-lower-bound-stronger, and it iterates the author's partite construction along the chain while keeping the clique-size bounds, which is what produces the exact product size. The theorem is the statement whose maximisation over chains gives the paper's lower-bound theorem, as the author notes immediately after it. H2.
